topics.name: UserModule Input Ingestion
topics.purpose: Define Input-type UserModule behavior as acquisition/validation of external or local source data followed by explicit write into the module instance's declared inert data surface.

semantics.validation_rule: Incoming value/payload validates against the declared input/schema contract before write.
semantics.write_rule: Validated input writes to the full `#UM` instance data surface or declared `#INPUT:*` child surface.
semantics.inert_rule: Written input is inert data and never directly executes commands/operations.
semantics.origin_rule: Source/origin provenance is retained where machine-significant.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Input listener/poller state is runtime state separate from input definition.
semantics.authority_rule: Ability to ingest/write input data does not grant arbitrary module mutation or command authority.

invariants.rule: UserModule type behavior is explicit and narrow: input acquires/writes inert data, adapter translates/mounts, view projects, and no type silently acquires another type's authority.

hard_gates.condition: payload writes outside declared instance/input surface
input runtime listener state treated as definition

references.purpose: Dynamic input instances use validated #INPUT:* children.
